nom: COSRX The Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow Hydrogel Mask

avis.titre: No dramatic results but a nice mask
avis.texte: I have used this mask 2x now, both times after using my PMD tool. I haven't seen any dramatic changes from using it, but I like the way my skin feels. I did notice that you're supposed to put on a serum first so I did that the last time.
I love this mask, i used it overnight and my skin was glowing and more firm the next day! Highly recommend
My skin feels amazing. My pimples feel and look smaller And I love the results
At 55 years old, I couldn't love these masks more than I already do. My skin seems softer and more plump after I use them.
A refreshing feeling while on, it absolutely makes a visible difference in one application! Definitely let it set for a few hours for full effect, but my face loves this!
This is my favorite collagen mask. It fits better than the other ones I tried on the market. Leaves a glowy and supple feel.
I LOVE the way my skin looks and feels when I wear this mask over night. I can easily sleep in it and my skin looks AMAZING when I wake up. Fresh face YAY!!
Gave as a gift to friends. Every single one showed immediate glowing results. Also doing wonders for the look and feel of my skin in its trouble areas.
Love to wear this overnight! So hydrating especially during the winter.

One of the best masks I've ever used. The results after wearing are fantastic. My skin looks tighter, refreshed and glowing. Recommended for 2-3 hours wear, sometimes I wear longer depending on how much time I have. Cosrx continues to make me a happy customer and people are always asking my for my skin routine. My skin has come a long way using their products. Highly recommend!!

It's a really intense mask that's thicker than regular masks, but I like it a lot. It stays on well overnight if you aren't someone who sleeps on their side. I definitely feel like my skin is moister and plumper the next day. I like to use it on long flights before landing.
These masks are the absolute best i have ever used. My skin is glowing and hydrated.
It looks great after you take it off and the skin feels healthy
My skin feels amazing and looks so refreshed after I use this. The results are amazing!
Got this as a free gift in my last order and immediately had to order the set. My skin looks so rejuvenated! Very happy with the results

I'm completely OBSESSED with the Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow Hydrogen Mask! I do my usual night time skincare routine and top it off with one of these masks. Yes, I do sleep in it all night! In the morning my skin looks glowy, hydrated, and ready for whatever comes. Its a definite must have! 10/10
It looks very nice. Results are almost immediate. You can see a difference after the first use. Ordering was easy.
Instant results especially when used overnight. It made my skin feel and look so smooth

Absolutely amazing! Also, If you are coming to the end of your injections, like dysport, or botox, these will absolutely carry you through for quite some time! Making you look amazing no matter what!!
This one is very good product. After I tried this mask pack I reordered 5 more boxes. I can feel this pack working good!
Love this results this mask provides. Leaves my skin supple and smooth and looking refreshed.
Tears a little easy but does a great job! No irritation. Don't tilt your head down for a couple minutes or it might slip a little.
